<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1770592_easy_t_0.FieldUpdater</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>FieldUpdater</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var FieldUpdater = Class.create();
FieldUpdater.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    updateField: function() {
        try {
            var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
            var sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
            var field = this.getParameter('sysparm_field');
            var value = this.getParameter('sysparm_value');
            
            var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
            if (gr.get(sysId)) {
                gr.setValue(field, value); // 更新指定字段
                gr.update();
                this.setAttribute('answer', 'success');
            } else {
                this.setAttribute('answer', 'Record not found');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            this.setAttribute('answer', 'Error: ' + e.message);
        }
    }
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-06 07:25:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>d7cd819cc3c26a109d5afeac050131ec</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FieldUpdater</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Easy to get" source="x_1770592_easy_t_0">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Easy to get">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d7cd819cc3c26a109d5afeac050131ec</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-06 13:46:55</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
